page.overview:
Who is Adele Kramer?

Dr. Adele Kramer is a character who features in Troy Young's Nyarlathotep Cycle of Cthulhu Mythos stories.

A woman in her early 30s, Adele Kramer is a marine biologist, formerly working at Dalhousie University, currently employed in the service of the Department of Extraordinary Phenomena, an agency which stands in opposition to "The Other": a catch-all term given to the forces of the Cthulhu Mythos.

After an encounter with an entity and its human thrall in the Canadian Arctic Circle on her first assignment for the agency, Adele was wounded: she later sported a bite scar across her cheek and was missing the ends of her left ring and pinky fingers.

Adele briefly possessed a wide range of extremely powerful psychic powers as a result of spending time in proximity to Azathoth, but saw this as more of a curse than a blessing. These abilities were later removed by the Outer God Yog-Sothoth as a reward for her service.
